Before we start, I would like to explain this survey.

VisionFund is collecting this information to understand how our services affect our clients and to improve our products.

Your participation is voluntary. Your answers will not affect your loan, insurance, or any other VisionFund services in any way.

Your responses will be kept confidential and analyzed together with other clients’ answers. We will not share your name or personal details in reports.

We may share anonymized survey data with trusted research or analysis partners to help us understand client experiences and improve our services.

You may skip any question, stop the survey at any time, or ask for your data to be deleted later.

Do you agree to participate in this survey?
